title: Beyond Bond Gauge: Exact Tensor-Network Tangent Spaces at Weighted Graph States
summary: For normal PEPS, the fundamental theorem settles at the finite level whether virtual-bond gauge exhausts a tensor network's representation freedom. We ask the first-order question at a fixed representation, from both sides of the differential: which tensor variations leave the state unchanged without being bond gauges, and which physical directions can no variation reach? We answer both exactly for weighted graph state (WGS) tensor networks with equal physical and bond dimension $q\ge2$, which include the graph-state resources of measurement-based quantum computation.
